example_sentences_in_bangla: কালাপানি পাড়ি দিয়ে নতুন জীবন শুরু করলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: The depth of the ocean is immeasurable in his poetry.
I crossed the ocean to start a new life.
history: Refers to the colonial-era 'Kalapani' punishment of exile to Andaman Islands; poetically used by Satyendranath Dutt to describe the ocean where pearls form in dark waters.
note: Primarily a literary term with historical undertones in Bengali culture.
